evals.prompt: Triage this external GitHub issue into a workon-ready packet without overwriting the reporter's original body.
evals.expected_output: A triage flow that preserves the source issue, produces gateway facts, proposes a linked normalized work request, and asks approval before forge changes.
assertions: Uses TriageGatewayInput facts before readiness claims
Includes canonical workon-ready headings in the normalized packet
Asks explicit approval before issue, label, or comment mutation

evals.prompt: A bug report says 'it broke' with no reproduction steps. Triage it for agent pickup.
evals.expected_output: A non-ready recommendation that requests concrete missing evidence and proposes the appropriate non-ready label instead of workon-ready.
assertions: Routes insufficient evidence to needs-info or additional-info-needed
Avoids implementing or guessing a root cause

evals.prompt: Triage a feature request that asks for a new plugin system, auth integration, UI, and migration docs in one issue.
evals.expected_output: A split recommendation or split table when review size is too broad, with approval requested before creating split issues.
assertions: Proposes splitting only because the scope is too broad
Keeps each proposed packet independently reviewable
Asks approval before creating or updating issues

evals.prompt: Prepare an improve-labeled packet for cleanup work in extensions/commands and tests/commands.
evals.expected_output: A canonical packet with a parser-valid git diff drift check and validation commands under Work Plan.
assertions: Includes a backtick-wrapped git diff --stat or git diff --name-only drift check with baseline and concrete paths
Keeps validation commands under Work Plan
Uses plain markdown bullets for acceptance criteria
